title: PACT Signed Event Delivery Envelope
description: The body POSTed to a subscriber endpoint on every push. Signed with the SENDING SERVER'S principal key (Section 17). A receiver MUST apply the 17.7 flow and MUST discard a delivery it cannot verify — an unverifiable push is not a push, and receivers MUST NOT act on the payload before verifying. The Mandate escalation_hook (20.2) uses this same envelope; there is no second webhook format. Added in PACT v2.1 (Section 21.3).

idempotency_key.description: STABLE across retries of the same event to the same subscription. A receiver MUST treat repeated deliveries bearing the same key as one event — this is what makes at-least-once delivery safe.

sent_at.description: Checked for freshness by the receiver within the 17.7 skew window.

attempt.description: 1-based attempt counter. Retries use exponential backoff WITH JITTER; dead-lettered after 24h (21.4).

sender_principal_id.description: DID of the sending server's principal.

alg.description: MUST be in the 17.6 normative whitelist.

signature.description: Signature over the canonical JSON (RFC 8785) encoding of this envelope with `signature` removed.
